patch.summary:
Thesis: General-purpose vs specialist — Adobe Marketo Engage documents a broader use-case set; Meltwater is narrower/specialist.

Comparison thesis: General-purpose vs specialist. Choose Adobe Marketo Engage only if your buying job matches “Enterprise B2B marketing automation platform (Adobe Marketo Engage) — custom quote; CRM se” rather than Meltwater's shape. Choose Meltwater only if your buying job matches “Enterprise media intelligence and social listening platform — custom modular packaging (St” rather than Adobe Marketo Engage's shape. Workflow advantage: Adobe Marketo Engage leans marketing-automation, lead-generation; Meltwater leans brand-monitoring. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: General-purpose vs specialist — Adobe Marketo Engage documents a broader use-case set; Meltwater is narrower/specialist.
- Positioning: Adobe Marketo Engage is Enterprise B2B marketing automation platform (Adobe Marketo Engage) — custom quote; CRM secondary.; Meltwater is Enterprise media intelligence and social listening platform — custom modular packaging (Starter/Pro/Enterprise/Agency)..
- Workflow coverage skew: Adobe Marketo Engage-leaning marketing-automation, lead-generation, lead-nurturing vs Meltwater-leaning brand-monitoring.
- Researched limits: Adobe Marketo Engage — Custom quote only — no public list-price transparency; Meltwater — Opaque custom pricing only.

Limitations — Adobe Marketo Engage: Custom quote only — no public list-price transparency; Implementation/ops overhead is enterprise-grade; Meltwater: Opaque custom pricing only; Not a social scheduler or publishing suite.

Poor-fit cases: Adobe Marketo Engage is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Custom quote only — no public list-price transparency · Meltwater is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Opaque custom pricing only · Avoid Adobe Marketo Engage if you actually need Meltwater's motion (Enterprise media intelligence and social listening platform — custom modular pac)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
